run_pipeline_step: run a PipelineStep subclass that processes a DocumentsPipeline generator with rank and world_size parameters
update_document_stats: update statistics for a Document including character length and token count metadata
update_media_stats: update statistics for a Media object tracking the size of media_bytes in bytes
track_processing_time: track the time a block of code takes to run and add it to pipeline statistics
register_pipeline_stats: register custom statistics labels with optional values and units for pipeline monitoring
